blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag asserted on Tuesday that it was former Davao City chief information officer Jefry Tupas who actually brought out that there were threats to his life—and not the bureau’s agents. Matibag said this in response to Tupas’ recent statement, alleging that the NBI “initiated efforts” to bring him to Manila on September 29 after agents who went to his house supposedly offered him security, as they had received a “verifiable threat” that he would be abducted by the Dutertes.
